prompt: The coach wants the team to be fast, focused, and ___ during every match.
explanation: Dua item pertama berbentuk sifat, maka item ketiga juga harus berbentuk sifat: calm.

prompt: She is not only a careful reader but also ___.
explanation: Pola not only X but also Y menuntut bentuk yang sejajar, sehingga a careful reader sejajar dengan a clear writer.

prompt: The writer's ___ conclusion fit into a single sentence, so the passage was easy to summarize.
explanation: Kesimpulan yang muat dalam satu kalimat berarti ringkas, dan kata yang tepat untuk itu adalah concise.

prompt: Because the poem's meaning was ___, two readers gave completely different interpretations.
explanation: Vague berarti tidak jelas atau kabur, sehingga pembaca bisa menafsirkannya secara berbeda.

prompt: Penulis menaruh tesis di kalimat pertama dan mendukungnya dengan tiga contoh.
acceptedAnswers: The writer placed the thesis in the first sentence and supported it with three examples.
The author put the thesis in the first sentence and backed it up with three examples.
explanation: Tesis biasanya diletakkan di awal paragraf, lalu didukung contoh; supported dan backed up sama-sama berarti mendukung.

prompt: Keberhasilan tim itu mengejutkan semua orang.
acceptedAnswers: The team's success surprised everyone.
The success of the team surprised everyone.
explanation: Keberhasilan adalah bentuk kata benda dari success, sedangkan surprised adalah kata kerja bentuk lampau.

passage: Rina had to write a report on the city's recycling program, and the article she found was twelve pages long. She did not read it word by word. First, she skimmed the headings and the opening paragraph to understand the main topic. Then she scanned the text for numbers, because her teacher wanted exact figures. She found the answer in the third section, where the city reported that 4,200 tons of plastic were collected last year. Before she started writing, she checked the thesis of the article again. Rina believed that a clear thesis would help her organize her own argument.
prompt: Apa yang dilakukan Rina pertama kali saat membaca artikel?

options.text: Membaca setiap kata dari awal sampai akhir
Menerjemahkan seluruh artikel ke bahasa Indonesia
Memindai angka tertentu di bagian ketiga
Membaca judul dan sekilas paragraf pembuka

explanation: Rina melakukan skimming dulu pada judul dan paragraf pembuka, baru kemudian memindai angka di bagian ketiga.

prompt: Tulis paragraf 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang cara kamu menemukan ide utama sebuah artikel pendek. Sebutkan tesisnya dan minimal satu detail pendukung.
modelAnswer: To find the main idea of a short article, I start by skimming the title, the opening lines, and the closing lines. The thesis is usually stated in the first paragraph, so I underline it while I read. Next, I look for supporting details that prove the thesis, such as examples, statistics, or quotations. Finally, I check whether every paragraph connects to the main claim. If the details all point in one direction, I can state the main idea in my own words.
explanation: Esai ini melatih kamu menyebut tesis lebih dulu, lalu menghubungkannya dengan detail pendukung.

script: Good morning, everyone. Today we are talking about parallel structure in lists and comparisons. When you write three items in a row, each item should use the same grammatical form. For example, 'We studied grammar, practiced listening, and reviewed vocabulary' is parallel, while 'We studied grammar, practicing listening, and vocabulary' is not. Please check your own essays for this pattern before the next class.
prompt: Menurut dosen, apa yang harus dicek mahasiswa pada esai mereka?

options.text: The length of each paragraph in the introduction
Whether the items in a list use the same grammatical form
Whether the title has a question mark
Whether every sentence starts with a capital letter

explanation: Dosen meminta mahasiswa memeriksa apakah item dalam sebuah daftar memakai bentuk tata bahasa yang sama.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Kami membaca sekilas bab itu untuk menangkap ide utamanya.'
acceptedAnswers: We skimmed the chapter to catch its main idea
explanation: Skimmed adalah bentuk lampau dari skim, yaitu membaca cepat untuk mendapat gambaran umum.

prompt: The advisor suggested that the student ___ the form before Friday.
explanation: Setelah suggest yang diikuti that, kata kerja memakai bentuk dasar, yaitu submit.

prompt: Hardly had the lecture started ___ the projector stopped working.
explanation: Pola hardly had lalu subjek lalu when berarti sesuatu baru saja dimulai lalu langsung terjadi hal lain, dan when adalah pasangannya.

prompt: The customer wanted to ___ about the late delivery, so he called the store manager.
explanation: Complain berarti mengeluh tentang sesuatu yang tidak memuaskan, seperti pengiriman yang terlambat.

prompt: When Dina ___ the invitation, she said she had a prior commitment.
explanation: Declined berarti menolak dengan sopan, dan alasan prior commitment menguatkan bahwa undangan itu ditolak.

prompt: Maaf, saya tidak bisa hadir di rapat besok karena ada ujian di jam yang sama.
acceptedAnswers: Sorry, I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow because I have an exam at the same time.
I am sorry, but I cannot make it to the meeting tomorrow because of an exam at the same time.
explanation: Kalimat ini memakai because untuk menyatakan alasan; attend dan come to sama-sama berarti hadir.

prompt: Dosen itu menjawab pertanyaan saya dengan sangat sabar.
acceptedAnswers: The lecturer answered my question very patiently.
The lecturer responded to my question very patiently.
explanation: Keterangan cara very patiently ditaruh setelah objek; answered dan responded sama-sama berarti menjawab.

passage: On Tuesday morning, Dimas went to the campus print center with a file that had to be printed before his class. The machine was not working, and the staff member at the counter looked tired. Dimas explained the problem politely, but he also said that the waiting line had been long for an hour. The staff member did not argue. She suggested that he use the self-service printer on the second floor, and she offered to print the first two pages for free. Dimas accepted the offer with thanks. Before he left, he asked whether the center could fix the broken printer soon. She replied that a technician would check it on Thursday.
prompt: Apa tanggapan petugas ketika Dimas mengeluh?

options.text: Dia menolak memperbaiki printer yang rusak
Dia meminta Dimas pulang dan mencetak file itu besok
Dia menyarankan printer swalayan dan menawarkan dua halaman gratis
Dia memarahi Dimas karena antre terlalu lama

explanation: Petugas menanggapi keluhan dengan menyarankan printer swalayan dan menawarkan dua halaman gratis.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang cara kamu menanggapi saran dari teman dengan sopan. Sertakan satu contoh kalimat balasan yang kamu gunakan.
modelAnswer: When a classmate gives me a suggestion, I first thank them for their idea. Then I explain what I have already tried, so the conversation stays clear and friendly. If I agree with the suggestion, I say that it is a helpful idea and ask how to start. If I disagree, I reply politely and give a reason. For example, I might say, 'Thanks for the tip, but I think the library will be too crowded today.'
explanation: Respons yang sopan biasanya berisi ucapan terima kasih, alasan, dan tanggapan yang jelas.

script: Hi, this is Professor Lee. I received your email about the extension request for the lab report. I can allow two extra days, but I cannot extend the deadline any further. Please send the revised file to my email by Thursday. If you need to talk, you can visit my office hours on Wednesday afternoon.
prompt: Apa yang disetujui dosen dalam pesan suara itu?

options.text: Three extra weeks for the lab report
No change to the deadline at all
A meeting in the library on Thursday
Two extra days for the lab report

explanation: Dosen hanya memberi dua hari tambahan dan menolak perpanjangan lebih dari itu.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Terima kasih atas saranmu, saya akan mencoba cara itu besok.'
acceptedAnswers: Thank you for your suggestion I will try that method tomorrow
explanation: Suggestion adalah kata benda untuk saran, dan try that method berarti mencoba cara itu.

prompt: The report ___ by three independent teams before it was published.
explanation: Laporan itu diperiksa oleh tim lain, jadi dipakai pasif was + V3; checked dan has checked tidak tepat.

prompt: Unless the author is credited, the paraphrase ___ as plagiarism.
explanation: Unless berarti kecuali jika, dan aturan umum di klausa utama memakai pasif kini: is treated.

prompt: To make a long explanation shorter, you can ___ it into two main points.
explanation: Condense berarti memadatkan, yaitu membuat teks lebih pendek tanpa kehilangan poin utamanya.

prompt: Her summary was ___ to the original article, keeping every key claim.
explanation: Faithful berarti setia atau akurat terhadap sumber, sehingga klaim utama tetap terjaga.

prompt: Penulis itu mengubah kalimat aslinya tanpa mengubah maknanya.
acceptedAnswers: The author changed the original sentence without changing its meaning.
The writer rewrote the original sentence without changing the meaning.
explanation: Mengubah susunan kata tetapi menjaga makna adalah inti dari parafrasa.

prompt: Ringkasan yang baik harus mempertahankan ide utama artikel.
acceptedAnswers: A good summary should keep the article's main idea.
A good summary must preserve the main idea of the article.
explanation: Keep dan preserve sama-sama berarti mempertahankan, sedangkan main idea adalah ide utama.

passage: The city water company published a notice about a planned shutdown. The original text was full of technical terms, and many residents could not understand when the water would stop. A local radio team decided to rewrite the notice in simpler words. They replaced the phrase 'scheduled maintenance interruption' with 'planned repair work,' and they explained that the supply would be cut from 8 a.m. to noon on Saturday. They also kept every key date and place, so no important fact was lost. Listeners said the new version was clearer, and several people wrote to thank the team for the explanation.
prompt: Apa tujuan tim radio menulis ulang pengumuman itu?

options.text: Agar pengumuman itu menjadi lebih panjang dan rinci
Agar tanggal dan tempat penting dihapus dari teks
Agar warga memahami pengumuman dengan bahasa yang lebih sederhana
Agar perusahaan air tidak perlu lagi memberi pengumuman

explanation: Tim radio menulis ulang pengumuman dengan kata-kata yang lebih sederhana, sambil tetap menjaga tanggal dan tempat penting.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang pengumuman kampus yang kamu baca minggu ini. Jelaskan ulang isinya dengan kata-katamu sendiri, lalu pastikan ide utamanya tetap sama.
modelAnswer: Last week, the campus announced that the main computer lab would close early on Thursday for network repairs. Students who needed a computer could use the library instead. In my own words, the school was fixing the internet system, so the lab would shut down before its usual hours. The message was clear, but it did not explain whether the repairs would affect the library. I still think the main point is accurate: the lab closes early, and students should plan another place to study.
explanation: Esai ini melatih parafrasa: isi tetap sama, tetapi susunan dan kata-katanya berbeda.

script: Attention students. The library will close at six tomorrow instead of nine because of the building inspection. Study rooms will remain open until eight for students who have a booking. Please bring your student card if you want to use the reading area in the evening. The updated schedule is posted on the campus website.
prompt: Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat merangkum pengumuman itu?

options.text: The library closes earlier than usual tomorrow, but booked study rooms stay open until eight.
Students can use the reading area all night without a card.
The library will stay open later than usual tomorrow.
The campus website has no information about tomorrow's schedule.

explanation: Pengumuman menyebut perpustakaan tutup lebih awal, sedangkan ruang belajar yang sudah dipesan tetap buka sampai pukul delapan.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Ringkasan itu memakai kata-kata yang lebih sederhana daripada artikel aslinya.'
acceptedAnswers: The summary uses simpler words than the original article
explanation: Pola than dipakai untuk membandingkan, dan simpler adalah bentuk perbandingan dari simple.

prompt: By the time the lecture ends, the students ___ all the notes.
explanation: By the time dengan waktu masa depan memakai future perfect, yaitu will have copied.

prompt: If the professor ___ the deadline, we would have more time to finish the essay.
explanation: Pengandaian yang tidak nyata di masa kini memakai bentuk lampau sederhana, yaitu extended, dengan would pada klausa utama.

prompt: The organizers wanted to ___ early, so they invited speakers two weeks in advance.
explanation: Get the ball rolling berarti memulai sesuatu agar mulai berjalan.

prompt: Please stop ___ around the bush and tell me the real reason you missed the meeting.
explanation: Beat around the bush berarti berbasa-basi dan tidak langsung ke inti pembicaraan.

prompt: Setelah seharian belajar, saya ingin berhenti dan beristirahat saja.
acceptedAnswers: After studying all day, I want to call it a day and rest.
After studying all day, I am ready to call it a day.
explanation: Call it a day berarti berhenti bekerja atau belajar untuk hari itu.

prompt: Dia menyimpan rahasia itu, tetapi akhirnya dia membocorkannya.
acceptedAnswers: She kept the secret, but in the end she spilled the beans.
She kept the secret, but eventually she let the cat out of the bag.
explanation: Spill the beans dan let the cat out of the bag sama-sama berarti membocorkan rahasia.

passage: Before the group presentation, the four students met in the library to plan their work. At first, every member had a different idea about the topic, and the discussion moved slowly. Maya finally asked everyone to write one sentence that explained the goal. When the sentences were read aloud, the group noticed that they were almost the same. 'Now we are all on the same page,' Maya said with a smile. The team divided the tasks, and Bagas agreed to finish the slides early. In the end, the presentation was clear and well organized.
prompt: Apa arti ungkapan 'on the same page' dalam cerita?

options.text: Semua anggota membaca buku halaman yang sama
Semua anggota memiliki pemahaman dan tujuan yang sama
Semua anggota menulis ulang bagian awal presentasi

explanation: On the same page berarti memiliki pemahaman yang sama, dan cerita menunjukkan hal itu lewat kalimat tujuan yang hampir identik.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang satu idiom yang kamu sukai. Jelaskan artinya, berikan contoh pemakaian, dan sebutkan apakah idiom itu cocok untuk tulisan formal.
modelAnswer: One idiom I like is 'once in a blue moon,' which means something happens very rarely. The expression is figurative, because the moon does not literally turn blue. For example, my grandmother visits the city once in a blue moon. This idiom is informal, so I would avoid it in a research report. In formal writing, I would use 'very rarely' instead.
explanation: Esai ini meminta kamu membedakan makna kiasan dan tingkat formalitas sebuah idiom.

script: Honestly, this project is going to be a lot of work, but we can bite the bullet and finish the draft by Sunday. Let's agree on the sources first. Once we agree, I will write the introduction, and you can handle the data section. If something is unclear, tell me directly. Just send me a message tonight.
prompt: Menurut pembicara, apa arti ungkapan 'bite the bullet' dalam konteks ini?

options.text: to eat a quick meal before the meeting
to argue loudly with a teammate
to accept a hard task and finish it

explanation: Bite the bullet berarti menerima tugas yang berat dan menyelesaikannya, bukan menghindarinya.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Gaya bahasa santai tidak cocok untuk surat lamaran kerja.'
acceptedAnswers: Casual language is not suitable for a job application letter
explanation: Casual language berarti gaya bahasa santai, dan kalimat ini menyatakan bahwa gaya itu tidak cocok untuk surat formal.

prompt: Neither the drivers nor the mechanic ___ available on Sunday.
explanation: Dalam neither-nor, bentuk to be mengikuti subjek kedua, yaitu mechanic yang tunggal, sehingga memakai was.

prompt: Unless the form is signed, the registrar ___ accept it.
explanation: Unless berarti kecuali jika, dan kondisi nyata di masa depan memakai will not pada klausa utama.

prompt: The school had a ___ of trained tutors, so the students waited longer for help.
explanation: Shortage berarti kekurangan, sehingga mahasiswa harus menunggu lebih lama untuk dibantu.

prompt: The landlord ___ to repair the heating for weeks, so the tenants complained.
explanation: Neglected berarti mengabaikan kewajiban, sehingga para penyewa mengeluh.

prompt: Dia tidak bisa hadir di kelas karena sakit parah.
acceptedAnswers: He was unable to attend the class because he was seriously ill.
He was unable to come to class because he was seriously sick.
explanation: Unable berarti tidak mampu, dan seriously ill atau seriously sick berarti sakit parah.

prompt: Perpustakaan itu tidak akan menerima buku yang rusak.
acceptedAnswers: The library will not accept damaged books.
The library refuses to accept damaged books.
explanation: Will not accept dan refuses sama-sama menyatakan penolakan; damaged berarti rusak.

passage: Last spring, the small town of Lakewood had only one bus route to the nearby city. Many workers depended on it, but the company said it was unable to keep the service at its old level. Drivers were scarce, and the company had no money to buy new buses. Residents were unwilling to accept fewer trips, so they organized a meeting at the town hall. Nobody expected a quick answer. However, the local council refused to ignore the problem, and it asked the company to explain the lack of drivers in a written report. Three weeks later, the company agreed to add one morning trip.
prompt: Apa yang akhirnya terjadi setelah warga mengadakan pertemuan?

options.text: Perusahaan setuju menambah satu perjalanan pagi
Warga memutuskan pindah ke kota lain

explanation: Setelah tiga minggu, perusahaan setuju menambah satu perjalanan pagi sebagai respons atas tekanan warga dan dewan kota.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang rencana yang gagal atau tidak bisa dijalankan. Gunakan minimal dua ekspresi negatif, misalnya unable, unlikely, refuse, atau lack.
modelAnswer: Last semester, our team planned a community food drive, but the plan failed for several reasons. We were unable to find a truck, and the school refused to lend its parking lot. It was unlikely that people would donate food on a rainy weekday, so we moved the event to Saturday. Unfortunately, there was a lack of volunteers, so the drive collected very little food. Next time, we will recruit more volunteers before choosing a date.
explanation: Esai ini melatih ekspresi negatif untuk menjelaskan kegagalan atau keterbatasan secara jelas.

script: Good morning, everyone. Unfortunately, the chemistry lab is unlikely to reopen before Monday because the ventilation system is still broken. Some students are unable to finish their experiments, and the technicians refuse to let anyone inside until the inspection is complete. There is also a lack of replacement equipment in the storage room. Please check the department website for updates.
prompt: Mengapa mahasiswa belum bisa menyelesaikan percobaan mereka?

options.text: Because the lab is open all weekend.
Because the ventilation system is broken and the lab is closed.
Because the technicians finished the inspection early.
Because the students were unwilling to finish their work.

explanation: Pengumuman menyebut sistem ventilasi masih rusak, sehingga laboratorium belum bisa dipakai.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Dia tidak mau menyerah meskipun sudah berkali-kali gagal.'
acceptedAnswers: He refuses to give up even after failing many times
explanation: Refuses menyatakan penolakan, to give up berarti menyerah, dan after failing many times berarti setelah berkali-kali gagal.

prompt: The advisor said that the registration forms ___ due the following Monday.
explanation: Dalam kalimat tidak langsung setelah said, bentuk kata kerja bergeser ke masa lampau, yaitu were.

prompt: I wish I ___ the deadline reminder before I missed the registration.
explanation: Wish untuk penyesalan tentang masa lalu memakai past perfect, yaitu had seen.

prompt: Before you enroll, check the course ___, which lists all topics and reading assignments.
explanation: Syllabus adalah dokumen yang berisi topik dan tugas bacaan setiap mata kuliah.

prompt: After paying the fee, the student received an official ___ showing all the courses he had passed.
explanation: Transcript adalah daftar nilai resmi yang memuat mata kuliah yang sudah lulus.

prompt: Pendaftaran kelas semester depan dibuka mulai Senin pagi.
acceptedAnswers: Registration for next semester's classes opens on Monday morning.
Registration for next semester classes opens Monday morning.
explanation: Opens berarti dibuka, sedangkan on Monday morning menunjukkan waktu pembukaannya.

prompt: Asrama hanya menerima pendaftaran sampai hari Jumat.
acceptedAnswers: The dormitory only accepts applications until Friday.
The dormitory accepts applications only until Friday.
explanation: Only dan until membatasi waktu penerimaan, sedangkan applications berarti pendaftaran.

passage: Ayu arrived at the university on a Sunday, two days before orientation. She was nervous about finding her way around the campus, so she checked the map in the lobby of the dormitory. The map was helpful, but she still got lost near the science building. A senior student noticed her confusion and offered to walk with her to the registration office. On the way, he explained that the library stays open until ten on weekdays and that the tutor center offers free writing help. Ayu thanked him, and she promised to visit the tutor center the following week, when her first essay was due.
prompt: Apa yang ditawarkan kakak tingkat kepada Ayu?
explanation: Kakak tingkat menawarkan diri untuk berjalan bersama Ayu ke kantor registrasi.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang kehidupan kampus yang kamu inginkan. Sebutkan satu hal tentang jadwal, satu tentang tempat belajar, dan satu tentang tugas.
modelAnswer: My ideal campus life starts with a flexible schedule that leaves room for rest and sports. I would like a quiet study area on every floor of the library, so students can focus without noise. Assignments should be spread across the semester, with clear deadlines posted on the portal. I also hope the tutor center stays open late during exam weeks. With these changes, students could balance their studies and their personal life.
explanation: Esai ini melatih kosakata kampus dan cara menyusun gagasan dengan tiga contoh yang jelas.

script: Hi, this is the housing office. Your dormitory application has been approved for the spring semester. Please confirm your room before Friday at noon, or the room will be offered to another student. You also need to bring a copy of your registration form to the front desk on Monday. If you have questions, call the office during working hours.
prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan mahasiswa sebelum Jumat siang?

options.text: Pay the tuition at the library.
Return a library book to the front desk.

explanation: Pesan itu meminta mahasiswa mengonfirmasi kamar asrama sebelum Jumat siang, atau kamar akan diberikan kepada orang lain.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Mahasiswa harus membawa kartu mahasiswa saat mengambil transkrip.'
acceptedAnswers: Students must bring their student card when they collect a transcript
explanation: Must bring menunjukkan kewajiban, dan collect a transcript berarti mengambil transkrip.

prompt: If the researchers ___ a larger sample, they could draw stronger conclusions.
explanation: Pengandaian yang tidak nyata di masa kini memakai past simple, yaitu collected, dengan could pada klausa utama.

prompt: The experiment, ___ in 2018, has been repeated by several teams.
explanation: Frasa participle pasif first conducted menunjukkan bahwa eksperimen itu dilakukan pertama kali pada 2018.

prompt: To check whether the result is real, other teams must ___ the experiment using the same method.
explanation: Replicate berarti mengulang eksperimen agar hasilnya bisa dipercaya.

prompt: The survey results were distorted by a strong ___, because most respondents came from one department.
explanation: Bias adalah kecenderungan tidak adil yang membuat hasil penelitian kurang akurat.

prompt: Hasil penelitian ini belum bisa digeneralisasi karena sampelnya terlalu kecil.
acceptedAnswers: The results of this study cannot be generalized because the sample is too small.
The findings of this study cannot be generalized because the sample is too small.
explanation: Generalisasi hanya sah jika sampel cukup besar, dan kalimat ini memakai bentuk pasif cannot be generalized.

prompt: Peneliti itu menjelaskan teorinya dengan data yang dikumpulkan selama tiga tahun.
acceptedAnswers: The researcher explained the theory using data collected over three years.
The researcher explained his theory using data that were collected over three years.
explanation: Frasa collected over three years memodifikasi data, sedangkan using menunjukkan cara menjelaskan.

passage: A psychology team wanted to know whether background noise affects reading speed. They invited forty volunteers to read the same article in two rooms. In the first room, students heard a steady noise from a fan. In the second room, the air was completely quiet. The researchers kept the lighting, chairs, and article the same in both rooms. The quiet room was used as the control group, because it showed the normal reading speed without extra sound. The results showed that readers in the noisy room finished about ten percent slower, although their comprehension scores did not change much.
prompt: Mengapa ruangan yang tenang digunakan sebagai kelompok kontrol?

options.text: Karena ruangan itu menunjukkan kecepatan membaca normal tanpa suara tambahan
Karena ruangan itu paling besar di antara keduanya
Karena volunter di ruangan itu membaca artikel yang berbeda
Karena peneliti ingin mengubah pencahayaan di ruangan itu

explanation: Kelompok kontrol dipakai sebagai pembanding normal, sehingga ruangan tanpa suara tambahan menunjukkan kecepatan baca yang wajar.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang hipotesis penelitian yang bisa kamu uji di kampus. Jelaskan hipotesismu, data yang akan dikumpulkan, dan mengapa hasilnya perlu diulang.
modelAnswer: My hypothesis is that students who read printed texts remember more details than students who read on a screen. To test this, I would give two groups the same article, one in print and one on a laptop. Afterward, both groups would answer the same set of questions about the content. I would collect the test scores and compare the averages to see whether the difference is meaningful. Because one study with a small sample can be misleading, the experiment should be repeated with more participants.
explanation: Esai ini melatih cara menyusun hipotesis, metode, dan alasan replikasi dalam penelitian.

script: Today we will look at a simple experiment about study music. Students in the experimental group listened to soft instrumental music while reading. Students in the control group read in complete silence. The researchers then compared the test scores, and they found only a small difference. Because the sample was only thirty students, the result should be repeated before we draw any firm conclusion.
prompt: Apa perbedaan antara kedua kelompok dalam eksperimen itu?

options.text: The experimental group read in silence, and the control group listened to music.
Both groups listened to music at the same volume.
Neither group took the reading test.
The experimental group listened to soft music, and the control group read in silence.

explanation: Kelompok eksperimen mendengar musik lembut, sedangkan kelompok kontrol membaca dalam keheningan total.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Setiap kelompok harus mencatat metode yang mereka pakai.'
acceptedAnswers: Each group must record the method they used
explanation: Must record menunjukkan kewajiban, dan method berarti metode atau cara kerja penelitian.

prompt: Anita should have ___ the reading earlier, because the quiz covered all of chapter three.
explanation: Should have ditambah bentuk ketiga kata kerja dipakai untuk menyesali hal yang tidak dilakukan di masa lalu.

prompt: The next seminar, ___ by two professors, will focus on sampling methods.
explanation: Bentuk pasif led menunjukkan bahwa seminar itu dipimpin oleh dua profesor.

prompt: The sudden rain was ___, so the outdoor exam was moved indoors.
explanation: Unexpected berarti tidak terduga, sehingga ujian di luar ruangan harus dipindahkan ke dalam.

prompt: Her reply was ___: she said maybe, but she gave no clear answer.
explanation: Tentative berarti belum pasti, dan jawaban maybe menunjukkan hal itu.

prompt: Tenggat pengumpulan laporan praktikum biasanya tidak bisa diubah.
acceptedAnswers: The deadline for submitting the lab report usually cannot be changed.
The lab report deadline usually cannot be changed.
explanation: Usually cannot be changed menyatakan aturan umum, dan submitting berarti pengumpulan.

prompt: Saya tidak yakin, tetapi mungkin saja dia sudah pulang.
acceptedAnswers: I am not sure, but she may have already gone home.
I am not certain, but it is possible that she has already gone home.
explanation: May have gone menyatakan kemungkinan yang sudah terjadi, sedangkan not sure berarti tidak yakin.

passage: Dani worked as an assistant in the psychology department, and his task was to summarize a long survey report for the student newsletter. The original report contained many statistics and technical words, such as 'correlation' and 'sample size.' Dani decided to explain the findings in plain language. He wrote that most students felt less stressed when they had a fixed study routine, and he showed the main chart in a simple table. He also kept the warning that the survey included only two hundred respondents. His editor praised the article, but she asked him to add a line about the limits of the study.
prompt: Apa tujuan utama Dani saat menulis ulang laporan survei?

options.text: Membuat laporan itu lebih panjang dengan istilah statistik
Menjelaskan temuan dengan bahasa sederhana untuk pembaca buletin
Menghapus semua batasan penelitian dari laporan
Mengganti semua angka dengan perkiraan kasar

explanation: Dani menjelaskan temuan dengan bahasa sederhana, sambil tetap mencantumkan batasan survei.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang cara kamu meninjau materi minggu ini. Sebutkan satu bagian yang sudah membaik dan satu bagian yang masih lemah.
modelAnswer: This week, I reviewed dialogues, paraphrasing, idioms, and negative expressions. I feel confident about identifying the second speaker's response in a short conversation. However, I still confuse some idioms with literal phrases, so I need more practice with them. I wrote down three new expressions and used each one in a sentence. Tomorrow, I will test myself with a short talk and check whether I can paraphrase the main idea.
explanation: Esai ini melatih refleksi belajar dengan menyebut kekuatan dan kelemahan secara spesifik.

script: Let's be realistic: the deadline is unlikely to change, and the lab cannot accept late reports. However, if you are unable to finish on time, you can ask the teaching assistant for a short extension. Don't hesitate to send your request before Thursday. The assistant will probably reply within two days.
prompt: Apa yang bisa dilakukan mahasiswa jika tidak bisa menyelesaikan tugas tepat waktu?

options.text: Ignore the deadline because it will not change.
Submit the report after the lab closes for the semester.
Ask the teaching assistant for a short extension before Thursday.
Change the lab schedule without telling anyone.

explanation: Pembicara menyarankan mahasiswa meminta perpanjangan singkat kepada asisten dosen sebelum Kamis.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Metode penelitian itu menjelaskan langkah yang bisa diikuti orang lain.'
acceptedAnswers: The research method describes the steps that other people can follow
explanation: Describes berarti menjelaskan, dan can follow berarti bisa diikuti.

prompt: Not until the timer rang ___ the students stop writing.
explanation: Kalimat yang dimulai dengan Not until membalik susunan menjadi did + subjek + kata kerja dasar.

prompt: Every section ___ a separate timer, so students should check it before starting.
explanation: Every selalu diikuti subjek tunggal, jadi kata kerjanya harus has.

prompt: The coach gave a rough ___ of our chances, saying we had about a one in three chance to win.
explanation: Estimate berarti perkiraan kasar, dan pelatih memberi angka kira-kira seperti itu.

prompt: To keep an even ___, I answer each question in about one minute.
explanation: Pace berarti kecepatan atau ritme pengerjaan, yang harus dijaga agar tetap stabil.

prompt: Saya harus menjaga ritme saat menjawab soal agar tidak kehabisan waktu.
acceptedAnswers: I must keep a steady pace while answering questions so that I do not run short of time.
I need to keep a steady rhythm while answering questions so that I do not run short of time.
explanation: Keep a steady pace berarti menjaga ritme yang stabil, dan run short of time berarti kekurangan waktu.

prompt: Hasil simulasi ini hanya perkiraan dan bukan nilai resmi.
acceptedAnswers: The result of this simulation is only an estimate, not an official score.
This simulation result is just an estimate and not an official score.
explanation: Estimate berarti perkiraan, sedangkan official score berarti nilai resmi.

passage: Bima took a timed practice test on Saturday morning. He started well, but he spent almost four minutes on one difficult question about sentence structure. When he looked at the timer, he realized that he had little time left for the last section. He quickly marked the question in his booklet and moved on. After finishing the rest of the section, he returned to the marked question and made a careful guess. Later, during the review, Bima wrote down that his pace was too slow in the middle of the test and that he should check the timer more often.
prompt: Apa yang dilakukan Bima ketika menyadari dirinya terlalu lama di satu soal?

options.text: Berhenti mengerjakan tes dan keluar dari ruangan
Menebak semua soal di bagian terakhir tanpa membaca
Menandai soal itu, lanjut, lalu kembali nanti
Mengabaikan waktu dan menyelesaikan soal itu sampai akhir

explanation: Bima menandai soal sulit, melanjutkan pekerjaan, lalu kembali membahasnya setelah bagian lain selesai.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang cara kamu mengatur waktu saat mengerjakan simulasi tes. Jelaskan cara kamu menandai soal sulit, menjaga kecepatan, dan memeriksa jawaban di akhir.
modelAnswer: During a timed simulation, I first check the timer and decide how many minutes I can spend on each section. When a question feels too difficult, I mark it in the booklet and move on immediately. I try to keep a steady pace, so I do not spend more than one minute on a single item. In the final minutes, I review my marked questions and make sure every answer is filled in. This method helps me finish the test calmly and with time to spare.
explanation: Esai ini melatih strategi waktu yang konkret untuk simulasi tes.

script: Good morning, everyone. This section has thirty questions, and you will have twenty-five minutes to complete them. When the timer reaches five minutes, please check that you have answered every item. If you are unsure about a question, mark it in the booklet and return to it later. Please stop writing as soon as the timer ends.
prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan peserta jika ragu dengan sebuah soal?

options.text: Mark the question in the booklet and return to it later.
Leave the answer blank and never return to it.
Stop the timer and ask the proctor for help.
Write the answer directly on the timer.

explanation: Peserta diminta menandai soal yang meragukan di buklet, lalu kembali membahasnya nanti.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Peserta harus memeriksa jawaban mereka sebelum waktu habis.'
acceptedAnswers: Participants must check their answers before the time runs out
explanation: Must menyatakan kewajiban, dan time runs out berarti waktu habis.

prompt: The score report would be more useful if it ___ a breakdown of each skill.
explanation: Pengandaian yang tidak nyata memakai past simple setelah if, sehingga bentuknya included.

prompt: I ___ my reading speed for three months, and the results are finally visible.
explanation: Present perfect continuous menunjukkan kegiatan yang berlangsung selama tiga bulan dan masih berlanjut.

prompt: After a difficult week, Dita kept studying every day, which shows her ___ in pursuing the goal.
explanation: Perseverance berarti kegigihan atau ketekunan dalam mengejar tujuan.

prompt: The low score was a temporary ___, not the end of her progress.
explanation: Setback berarti kemunduran sementara, sehingga nilai rendah itu tidak mengakhiri kemajuannya.

prompt: Catatan refleksi saya menunjukkan bahwa latihan membaca sudah membaik.
acceptedAnswers: My reflection notes show that my reading practice has improved.
My reflection notes show that my reading practice has gotten better.
explanation: Has improved menyatakan perubahan yang sudah terjadi sampai sekarang.

prompt: Setelah sebulan tanpa kemajuan, dia mulai mengubah cara belajarnya.
acceptedAnswers: After a month without progress, she started changing the way she studied.
After one month without progress, she began to change how she studied.
explanation: Without progress berarti tanpa kemajuan, sedangkan started changing dan began to change sama-sama berarti mulai mengubah.

passage: Taufik kept a practice log for three months. Every Sunday, he wrote his reading score, the time he spent on each passage, and one thing he wanted to improve. For several weeks, his numbers barely moved, and he began to feel discouraged. Instead of quitting, he reviewed his log and noticed a pattern: he rushed through the final paragraph of every passage. He changed his method, read the last paragraph first to know the purpose, and then returned to the start. Within two weeks, his score began rising again. Taufik called this change his turning point, because it gave him a clear next step.
prompt: Apa yang paling membantu Taufik keluar dari masa mandek?

options.text: Berhenti berlatih selama satu bulan penuh
Menyalin jawaban dari teman yang nilainya lebih tinggi
Mengubah cara membaca dengan memeriksa paragraf terakhir lebih dulu

explanation: Taufik menemukan pola kesalahannya dan mengubah cara membaca, sehingga skornya kembali naik.

prompt: Tulis 4 sampai 6 kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris tentang refleksi setelah simulasi TOEFL ITP. Sebutkan satu kekuatanmu, satu kelemahanmu, dan satu langkah berikutnya.
modelAnswer: After the full simulation, I reviewed my scores and wrote a short reflection. My main strength is reading comprehension, because I could find the main idea quickly in most passages. My weakness is structure, especially questions about word order and verb forms. Therefore, my next step is to spend fifteen minutes each day on grammar patterns. I also plan to set a milestone that I can measure at the end of two weeks.
explanation: Esai ini melatih refleksi yang spesifik: kekuatan, kelemahan, dan rencana tindak lanjut.

script: Hi everyone, let's review the estimated score conversion together. Remember that this estimate is only a practice guide, not your official result. If your reading score is strong but your structure score is low, your roadmap should focus on grammar patterns. Please write one milestone for the next two weeks. Bring your reflection notes to the next session.
prompt: Menurut pembicara, apa yang sebaiknya difokuskan jika skor struktur rendah?

options.text: Focus the roadmap on grammar patterns.
Treat the estimate as an official result.
Skip the reflection notes this week.

explanation: Jika skor struktur rendah, peta jalan belajar sebaiknya difokuskan pada pola tata bahasa.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang berarti: 'Refleksi rutin membantu saya melihat kemajuan sebelum saya merasa ingin menyerah.'
acceptedAnswers: Regular reflection helps me see my progress before I feel like giving up
explanation: Helps me see berarti membantu saya melihat, dan feel like giving up berarti merasa ingin menyerah.
